power.jaymospowers.smoke.desc: You make smoke, and it's real: it billows, climbs, fills rooms, leaks under doors and drifts on the wind. Nothing sees through it but you.
power.jaymospowers.smoke.key.starter: Faint Vapour Form: your legs turn to smoke and you fly on it, slower and with a thinner trail than you will; R again lands
power.jaymospowers.smoke.key.ability_1: Vapour Form: everything below your waist turns to smoke and you fly on it like the wind (Sprint to cruise, S to brake); shots pass through the smoke; R again lands. Fully mastered, cruising turns your whole body to smoke: nothing can hurt you, shots and creatures pass through, and you seep through anything short of a full block, but you can't strike or use abilities
power.jaymospowers.smoke.key.ability_2: Smokescreen (hold): thick smoke pours out of you for up to 10 s; it rises, fills the room and hides whoever is in it. Mastered, the cloud holds against the wind and lasts 3x longer
power.jaymospowers.smoke.key.ability_2.c: Smog Bank (hold): toxic smog pours out of you for up to 10 s; anyone but you with their head in it is poisoned, and what grows under it dies
power.jaymospowers.smoke.key.ability_3: Smoke Bomb: throw a ball that bursts into a big cloud where it lands, blinding whoever is right by it
power.jaymospowers.smoke.key.ability_3.c: Choke Bomb: a ball that bursts into a cloud of smog; whoever it blinds is poisoned and coughs out smog of their own
power.jaymospowers.smoke.key.ability_4: Smother (hold): smoke wraps whoever you aim at (24 blocks), blinding and slowing them while their air runs out, then they choke
power.jaymospowers.smoke.key.ability_4.c: Black Lung (hold): smog fills whoever you aim at (24 blocks); they choke half again as fast and breathe out a poison cloud on those round them every second
power.jaymospowers.smoke.key.special: Smoke Jet (hold): a jet of smoke where you look (14 blocks) that lingers like your other smoke, drives smoke on and fills a ship's sails. Sneak + X: Smoke Step, come apart and re-form inside one of your own thick clouds under the crosshair (32 blocks, through walls)
power.jaymospowers.smoke.key.special.cor: Soot Jet (hold): a black jet of smog where you look (14 blocks) that blinds what it catches. Sneak + X: Smoke Step
power.jaymospowers.smoke.key.mode: Smoke Sight (toggle): every creature standing in smoke within 32 blocks is outlined through walls (dark for the hostile), and your own smoke is barely drawn; costs a little hunger while on
power.jaymospowers.smoke.key.mode.name: Smoke Sight
power.jaymospowers.smoke.key.ultimate: Harness the Sky: tap to call a raincloud where you aim (puts out fires, waters crops); hold under a storm to calm it (a supercell never puts down its tornado), or at a tornado to unwind it a rank at a time while it drags you in
power.jaymospowers.smoke.key.ultimate.co: Pyroclasm: hold to gather, let go, and a burning cloud of smog and ash rolls out along the ground where you look (12-24 blocks), setting what it passes alight
power.jaymospowers.smoke.key.ultimate.as: Ash Storm: tap for a black storm over you for 30 s (ash, darkness, lightning on hostiles and whoever hurt you). Sneak + tap: a raincloud of soot that blinds. Hold: calm a storm, or unwind a tornado until it dies (that burns your corruption away). Sneak + hold under a supercell or your own storm: feed it a tornado where you aim
message.jaymospowers.smoke_vapour_on: Vapour Form on: sprint to take off.
message.jaymospowers.smoke_step_none: No thick smoke of yours there to step into.
message.jaymospowers.smoke_feed_nothing: There's no storm here to feed.
message.jaymospowers.smoke_feed_touchdow: The storm reaches down where you point.
message.jaymospowers.smoke_tornado_kille: The tornado comes apart, and the ash in you burns away with it. You doubt it is gone for good.
message.jaymospowers.smoke_calm_thunder: The thunder dies away into rain.
message.jaymospowers.smoke_smog_hint: Your throat burns. The smoke is getting into you...
message.jaymospowers.smoke_smog_whisper: The air is thinner up here, and cleaner...
message.jaymospowers.smoke_smog_cured_ai: A long breath of clean air, and the smog in you clears.
message.jaymospowers.smoke_smog_cured_ra: The rain washes the smog out of you.
message.jaymospowers.smoke_smog_cured_da: Days have passed, and the smog in you has thinned to nothing.
